rationale: Lactate and arabinose are primary fermentable substrates; arginine + glycine Stickland reaction provides carbon and nitrogen. Fermentation yields acetate, propionate, formate, and CO₂. Carbon budget: 60.5 in, 38 out, ~22.5 for growth (~0.5 gDW); nitrogen marginal at 9.5 mmol. Growth rate limited by nitrogen availability.
